Name: Cheaper Gold Clock
Author: gremlinsoup
Description:
Content patcher mod that changes the Gold Clock to cost 1,000,000g and 100 Gold Bars.

For players who don't enjoy playing just for profit, but still want to get the gold clock without grinding/making a huge winery. Adding the gold bar cost still makes it a bit of an accomplishment to get.


IF YOU WANT TO CONFIGURE: open content.json and change the value next to "BuildCost" for the monetary price, and "Amount" for gold bar price.






Also, this is my first mod! I'm not actually 100% sure what I'm doing, but I did manage to make it. Hope it helps someone :D

Manifest.Name: Cheaper Gold Clock
Manifest.Description: Decreases the price of the Gold Clock
